# My OSINT Training - Tools Site

> A growing collection of free browser bookmarklets for OSINT investigators. Drag, click, done — no extensions, no accounts required.

## Docs
- [Tool Catalog](https://tools.myosint.training/): the full bookmarklet list
- [Blog](https://www.myosint.training/pages/blog): write-ups on new bookmarklets
- [Courses](https://www.myosint.training): courses and OSINT training

## Notes
All bookmarklets run entirely client-side in the visitor's own browser — no data is sent to My OSINT Training when they're used.
